| {{OEIS link|A086747}} 
|-

|-

| 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 24, 48, 72, 144, 240,&nbsp;...
| Each number {{mvar|k}} on this list has more solutions to the equation {{math|''φ''(''x'') {{=}} ''k''}} than any preceding {{math|''k''}}.

|-

| {{OEIS link|A122045}} 
|-

| 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 17,&nbsp;...

|-

| 0, 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28, 36, 45,&nbsp;...

== Types of primes ==
{{Main|List of prime numbers}}
{|class="wikitable sortable"
! Name !! First elements !! Short description !! OEIS
|-
| [[Mersenne prime]] exponents 
| 2, 3, 5, 7, 13, 17, 19, 31, 61, 89,&nbsp;...
| Primes {{math|''p''}} such that {{math|2<sup>''p''</sup> − 1}} is prime.
| {{OEIS link|A000043}} 
|-
| [[Mersenne prime]]s
| 3, 7, 31, 127, 8191, 131071, 524287, 2147483647, 2305843009213693951, 618970019642690137449562111,&nbsp;...
| {{math|2<sup>''p''</sup> − 1}} is prime, where {{math|''p''}} is a prime. 
| {{OEIS link|A000668}}
|-
| [[Wagstaff prime]]s
| 3, 11, 43, 683, 2731, 43691,&nbsp;...
| A prime number ''p'' of the form <math>p={{2^q+1}\over 3}</math> where ''q'' is an odd prime.
| {{OEIS link|A000979}}
|-
| [[Wieferich prime]]s 
| 1093, 3511
| | Primes <math>p</math> satisfying {{math|2<sup>''p''−1</sup> ≡ 1 (mod ''p''<sup>2</sup>)}}. 
| {{OEIS link|A001220}} 
|-
| [[Sophie Germain prime]]s 
| 2, 3, 5, 11, 23, 29, 41, 53, 83, 89,&nbsp;...
| A prime number {{math|''p''}} such that {{math|2''p'' + 1}} is also prime.
| {{OEIS link|A005384}} 
|-
| [[Wilson prime]]s 
| 5, 13, 563
| | Primes <math>p</math> satisfying {{math|(''p''−1)! ≡ −1 (mod ''p''<sup>2</sup>)}}.
| {{OEIS link|A007540}} 
|-
| [[Happy number]]s 
| 1, 7, 10, 13, 19, 23, 28, 31, 32, 44,&nbsp;...
| The numbers whose trajectory under iteration of sum of squares of digits map includes {{math|1}}.
| {{OEIS link|A007770}} 
|-
| [[Factorial prime]]s 
| 2, 3, 5, 7, 23, 719, 5039, 39916801,&nbsp;...
| A prime number that is one less or one more than a [[factorial]] (all factorials > 1 are even).

|-
| [[Wolstenholme prime]]s

| Primes <math>p</math> satisfying <math>{2p-1 \choose p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{p^4}</math>.

|-

| The {{math|''n''}}<sup>th</sup> Ramanujan prime is the least integer {{math|''R''<sub>''n''</sub>}} for which {{math|''π''(''x'') − ''π''(''x''/2) ≥ ''n''}}, for all {{math|''x'' ≥ ''R''<sub>''n''</sub>}}.
| {{OEIS link|A104272}}
